products.name: EX Legend Maker Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs. The Pikachu delta secret rare that Elite Fourum's rarity guide puts on top of a box is not simulated (it is in no pack).
